content: Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) is particularly advantageous for individuals with diabetes who are at an elevated risk of experiencing either hypoglycemia or hyperglycemia, especially those who are on insulin therapy. CGM technology provides real-time data on glucose fluctuations and trends, enabling both patients and healthcare providers to make more precise and informed decisions regarding their treatment strategies. Metrics derived from CGM, such as Time in Range (TIR), Time Above Range, and Time Below Range, are critical tools for assessing glucose control. These metrics allow for the optimization of treatment plans to achieve improved glycemic outcomes.
